answer: Issue every agent a TPM-bound identity card: a hardware chip signs each deal, so one machine holds one card. First, the agent buys a $40 TPM chip and registers its public key on-chain. Second, every trade must carry a fresh chip signature, and two cards sharing one chip get both revoked. Third, a caught fake loses its card and its $200 escrow deposit. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $400,000 in chips plus $2,000,000 in escrow and 21 days of checks. Like a desert canyon with one narrow pass, only the traveler who paid for oasis water and crossed the dune with a real map reaches the far side.
